templates.appropriate_for: Repeated measurements or estimates with a defined uncertainty interval.
templates.avoid_when: The band has no documented statistical meaning or independent series are connected as repeated data.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace fmri demo data, define the estimator and interval, and retain line-style redundancy.

templates.appropriate_for: A small number of methods compared over the same categories with a meaningful zero baseline.
templates.avoid_when: There are many groups, zero is irrelevant, or uncertainty definitions differ.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace tips data, document error bars, add direct values when useful, and add hatch for grayscale.

templates.appropriate_for: Comparing distributions across two categorical factors.
templates.avoid_when: Samples are too sparse or raw observations are necessary to expose structure.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace tips data, report sample sizes, and overlay raw points when affordable.

templates.appropriate_for: Many categories with long labels and comparable numeric distributions.
templates.avoid_when: Ordering has no meaning or outliers are hidden without explanation.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace iris data, sort categories by a declared statistic, and preserve outlier semantics.

templates.appropriate_for: Two quantitative axes plus a defensible positive magnitude encoded by area.
templates.avoid_when: Bubble size represents signed values, precise size comparison is required, or points heavily overlap.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace mpg data, use perceptual area scaling, and add marker redundancy for categories.

templates.appropriate_for: Showing how a few groups contribute to counts across common bins.
templates.avoid_when: Group shapes must be compared precisely or bin choice would dominate the conclusion.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace penguins data, declare bins and normalization, and show group sample sizes.

templates.appropriate_for: Comparing complete distributions without choosing histogram bins.
templates.avoid_when: There are too many groups or weighted observations are not handled explicitly.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace penguins data, add line-style redundancy, and annotate decision-relevant quantiles.

templates.appropriate_for: Checking systematic residual structure, heteroscedasticity, and outliers after fitting.
templates.avoid_when: Residuals are computed on training data only or their sign convention is unstated.
templates.required_adaptation: Use held-out residuals when claimed, label zero, and state residual definition and scale.

templates.appropriate_for: A compact matrix with meaningful row/column labels and common scale.
templates.avoid_when: Cells are not comparable or a diverging midpoint has no scientific interpretation.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace flights data, choose a semantic colormap, label the colorbar, and limit visible annotations.

templates.appropriate_for: Matched observations across ordered conditions with a real pairing key.
templates.avoid_when: Observations are independent or connecting lines imply nonexistent correspondence.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace exercise data, preserve pairing IDs, and distinguish individual paths from the aggregate.

templates.appropriate_for: A few aligned time series sharing units and sampling times.
templates.avoid_when: Series use different units or dense lines obscure the decision-relevant trend.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace flights data, use direct labels or a compact legend, and add line-style redundancy.

templates.appropriate_for: Comparing component values against explicit totals across categories.
templates.avoid_when: Components do not share a common whole or totals vary without being shown.
templates.required_adaptation: Replace crashes data, state the denominator, sort deliberately, and label important differences.
